2608.10929.title: FedCGR: Federated Cross-Domain Generative Recommendation
2608.10929.paper_summary: Cross-domain recommendation (CDR) transfers preference knowledge across related domains, but federated deployment makes cross-domain alignment difficult because the behavioral anchors that align item spaces, such as overlapping users and shared interaction signals, are often sparse, unavailable, or privacy-sensitive across clients. To address this tension, we revisit federated CDR as generation over a stable semantic item language. By representing items as discrete semantic ID (SID) sequences derived from public item-side metadata, cross-domain item alignment is induced by a shared vocabulary rather than by exchanging private interactions or aligning domain-specific embeddings. Directly federating SID-based generators, however, introduces two design constraints: the SID tokenizer must remain fixed to preserve cross-client token consistency, which creates a semantic-only bottleneck because local collaborative filtering (CF) signals cannot be globally shared or aligned; meanwhile, standard federated averaging can cause negative transfer under domain heterogeneity. To overcome these constraints, we propose FedCGR, a federated generative CDR framework that keeps the item language stable and makes adaptation explicit. FedCGR injects local CF evidence through a reliability-aware semantic interface and trains a prototype-personalized generator that selectively aggregates shared parameters according to domain relatedness while keeping domain-specific quantities local. Experiments on six Amazon cross-domain scenarios show that FedCGR consistently outperforms federated generative baselines and achieves competitive performance against strong sequential and federated CDR methods under both full-ranking and sampled evaluation protocols.
2608.10929.paper_summary_zh: 跨域推薦（CDR）在相關領域之間傳遞偏好知識，但聯邦部署使得跨域對齊變得困難，因為對齊項目空間的行為錨點，例如重疊用戶和共享互動信號，通常在客戶端之間是稀疏的、不可用的或隱私敏感的。為了解決這一矛盾，我們重新審視聯邦 CDR，將其視為在穩定的語義項目語言上進行生成。通過將項目表示為源自公共項目側元數據的離散語義 ID（SID）序列，跨域項目對齊是通過共享詞彙來誘導的，而不是通過交換私有互動或對齊特定領域的嵌入。然而，直接聯邦化基於 SID 的生成器引入了兩個設計約束：SID 分詞器必須保持固定以保持跨客戶端的標記一致性，這造成了一個僅限語義的瓶頸，因為本地協同過濾（CF）信號無法全局共享或對齊；同時，標準的聯邦平均在領域異質性下可能導致負遷移。為了克服這些約束，我們提出了 FedCGR，一個聯邦生成 CDR 框架，它保持項目語言的穩定並使適應性變得明確。FedCGR 通過一個可靠性感知的語義介面注入本地 CF 證據，並訓練一個原型個性化生成器，根據領域相關性選擇性地聚合共享參數，同時保持特定領域的數量在本地。對六個亞馬遜跨域場景的實驗表明，FedCGR 始終優於聯邦生成基準，並在全排名和抽樣評估協議下對強大的序列和聯邦 CDR 方法達到競爭性能。
